Subject: Renewal: evidence routing + PO staging for expansion

Hi Alice / Sunvale procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — we appreciate the partnership. Per our call, here are the concrete next steps to get the renewal and the planned capacity uplift over the finish line: 

1) SOW and signature: Attached is Sunvale_SOW_v2.pdf (minor CLARITY edits only). We can send via DocuSign if that helps speed routing.
2) Procurement portal evidence: I attached a short Evidence_List_Sunvale.xlsx with the set of items your portal will require (SOC2 attestation, data retention table, contact for incident response, sample SLA). We can pre-populate the portal on your behalf if you confirm an upload contact and portal account for Redwood.
3) PO staging: Please confirm expected PO format (PO# pattern, delivery email for invoices). We typically need the PO to be issued to Redwood Inference, Inc. and routed to acctspayable@redwoodinference.com unless you require a different billing flow.
4) Expansion timing: Once signed + PO issued we can schedule the capacity increase (from 350k tokens/month to 600k/month and a reserved concurrency bump) — target go-live date requested by Sunvale: 2026-09-28.

Can you confirm: (a) procurement contact to receive pre-fill, (b) desired PO number format, and (c) whether Finance needs a W-9 or vendor form attached to the portal entry?

I attached the SOW and evidence list to speed things up. If helpful I can pre-stage items in the portal today and loop Ben (pricing lead) and Laura (CS) on the final checklist.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0137

Attachments: Sunvale_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf), Evidence_List_Sunvale.xlsx (xlsx)

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear note.

We can do a pre-populate of the portal, that would be helpful. A couple quick clarifications from procurement:
- PO format is: SV-YYYY-##### (we'll provide final PO# once finance issues it).
- For portal upload we need Redwood to use this portal account: vendors@sunvale.health (we will create an upload folder labeled "Redwood - Renewal 2026").
- Finance does require a current W-9 and bank wiring info. If you can attach those to the portal upload that will speed processing.

I noticed the SOW has the expansion quantities — procurement will need the line-item invoice amounts for the additional capacity (you can send an estimated invoice or a pre-billed PO value). We plan to route the PO to Finance by Thu, Sep 24.

I'll loop procurement@sunvale.health on this thread for the upload account and formal PO. If you can pre-stage the evidence this week, that will help us meet the Sept 28 go-live.

Best,
Alice Moreno
Director of Vendor Management | Sunvale Health
